#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

using Real = double;

// 3D index calculation
inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {
    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;
}

void initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                grid[idx] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;
            }
        }
    }
}

// 7-point stencil computation
void stencilIteration(const std::vector<Real>& input, 
                      std::vector<Real>& output,
                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    // Process interior points (not on boundaries)
    for (size_t z = 1; z < nz - 1; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 1; y < ny - 1; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 1; x < nx - 1; ++x) {
                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                
                const Real center = input[idx];
                const Real left = input[idx3(x-1, y, z, nx, ny)];
                const Real right = input[idx3(x+1, y, z, nx, ny)];
                const Real front = input[idx3(x, y-1, z, nx, ny)];
                const Real back = input[idx3(x, y+1, z, nx, ny)];
                const Real bottom = input[idx3(x, y, z-1, nx, ny)];
                const Real top = input[idx3(x, y, z+1, nx, ny)];
                
                // Simple averaging stencil
                output[idx] = (center + left + right + front + back + bottom + top) / 7.0;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Copy boundary values
    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {
                if (x == 0 || x == nx-1 || y == 0 || y == ny-1 || z == 0 || z == nz-1) {
                    const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);
                    output[idx] = input[idx];
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {
    // Simple sanity checks
    
    // 1. No NaN or Inf values
    for (const auto& val : grid) {
        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {
            printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)
    Real minVal = grid[0];
    Real maxVal = grid[0];
    for (const auto& val : grid) {
        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);
        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);
    }
    
    printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", minVal, maxVal);
    
    // After averaging, values should be somewhat bounded
    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {
        printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
        return false;
    }
    
    // 3. Boundary values should not change significantly
    // (they are copied, so they should be close to initial values)
    
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\n");
    printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    printf("  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    size_t nx = 128;
    size_t ny = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified
    size_t nz = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified
    int iterations = 10;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-x") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-y") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-z") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;
    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;
    
    printf("3D Stencil Benchmark\n");
    printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
    printf("Iterations: %d\n", iterations);
    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    
    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;
    
    // Allocate grids (double buffering)
    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);
    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);
    
    // Initialize
    printf("Initializing grid...\n");
    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);
    
    // Run stencil iterations
    printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {
        if (iter % 2 == 0) {
            stencilIteration(grid1, grid2, nx, ny, nz);
        } else {
            stencilIteration(grid2, grid1, nx, ny, nz);
        }
    }
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
    
    printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n", duration.count());
    
    // Calculate performance metrics
    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;
    double mcups = cellUpdates / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second
    printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
    
    // Print results for external validation
    const std::vector<Real>& finalGrid = (iterations % 2 == 0) ? grid1 : grid2;
    if (printResults) {
        print_results(finalGrid, "Grid");
    }
    
    // Validation
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating result...\n");
        bool valid = validateResult(finalGrid, nx, ny, nz);
        
        if (valid) {
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};

    for (size_t z = 1; z < nz - 1; ++z) {
        for (size_t y = 1; y < ny - 1; ++y) {
            for (size_t x = 1; x < nx - 1; ++x) {

                // Simple averaging stencil

The workload is a double-precision, memory-bandwidth-bound 7-point Jacobi stencil. I’ll keep both time levels resident on the GPU, use coalesced X-direction access with reusable neighboring values, synchronize only once after all iterations, and copy back only the final grid. Boundary cells will still be copied every iteration exactly as before.

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {

+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;

+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);

     }

+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
         }
     }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }

+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};

+// block advances through a short Z slab so that the two Z neighbours can be
+// retained in registers rather than reloaded for every output cell.
+constexpr unsigned kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
         }
     }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }

+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};

+    ~CudaEvent() { cudaEventDestroy(event_); }
+    cudaEvent_t get() const noexcept { return event_; }
+
+  private:

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;

+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;

+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {

+        first[index] = value;

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;

+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1)
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX)
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);

+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;

+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];

+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {

+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.

+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledFront = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX);
+        const Real shuffledBack = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX);
+        const Real left = localX != 0

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
-    
-    // Copy boundary values
-    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {

+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledFront = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX);
+        const Real shuffledBack = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? shuffledFront
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? shuffledBack
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
         }
     }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }
+
+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};

+// A warp covers an 8x4 XY tile.  Its four in-plane neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the tile-edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.  This cuts the steady-state input traffic from seven loads per
+// update to fewer than two without shared-memory bank conflicts.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {

     }
-

+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledFront = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX);
+        const Real shuffledBack = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, kWarpTileX);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = localY != 0
+            ? shuffledFront
+            : input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = localY + 1 < kWarpTileY && y + 1 < ny - 1
+            ? shuffledBack
+            : input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }

+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
         }
     }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }

+  private:

+};

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));

+// A warp covers one contiguous 32-cell X row.  X neighbours are exchanged

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

codex
The spatial tiling variants are correct but do not beat the register-swept baseline consistently; the extra synchronization/shuffle instructions offset the saved loads. I’m testing a more consequential optimization now: fusing two Jacobi time steps per launch with a radius-two tile. This reduces kernel-launch count and global-memory round trips while still computing the same intermediate values and fixed boundaries.

+// A warp covers one contiguous 32-cell X row.  X neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the two edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 1;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;

+constexpr unsigned kInputY = kTemporalY + 4;

+constexpr unsigned kMiddleY = kTemporalY + 2;

+constexpr unsigned kMiddlePitch = kMiddleX + 1;

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+                       + initial[localZ][localY + 1][localX + 1]
+                       + initial[localZ + 2][localY + 1][localX + 1]) / 7.0;
             }
         }
+        middle[localZ][localY][localX] = value;
     }

+
+    constexpr unsigned outputPlaneCells = kTemporalX * kTemporalY;
+    constexpr unsigned outputCells = outputPlaneCells * kTemporalZ;
+    for (unsigned local = thread; local < outputCells; local += kTemporalThreads) {
+        const unsigned localZ = local / outputPlaneCells;
+        const unsigned inPlane = local - localZ * outputPlaneCells;
+        const unsigned localY = inPlane / kTemporalX;
+        const unsigned localX = inPlane - localY * kTemporalX;
+        const size_t globalX = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTemporalX + localX;
+        const size_t globalY = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTemporalY + localY;
+        const size_t globalZ = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kTemporalZ + localZ;
+        if (globalX < nx - 1 && globalY < ny - 1 && globalZ < nz - 1) {
+            const Real center = middle[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 1];
+            const Real sum = center
+                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX]
+                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 2]
+                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY][localX + 1]
+                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY + 2][localX + 1]
+                           + middle[localZ][localY + 1][localX + 1]
+                           + middle[localZ + 2][localY + 1][localX + 1];
+            output[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX] = sum / 7.0;
+        }
+    }

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }
+
+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};

+  private:

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}
+
+// Evaluate two Jacobi time steps in one launch.  The first step is computed for
+// the output tile plus a one-cell halo; consequently every value needed by the
+// second step is local and no inter-block synchronization is required.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTemporalThreads)
+void stencilTwoStepsKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
+                           Real* __restrict__ output,
+                           const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    __shared__ Real initial[kInputZ][kInputY][kInputPitch];
+    __shared__ Real middle[kMiddleZ][kMiddleY][kMiddlePitch];
+
+    const unsigned thread = threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    constexpr unsigned inputPlaneCells = kInputX * kInputY;
+    constexpr unsigned inputCells = inputPlaneCells * kInputZ;
+
+    // The radius-two input starts one coordinate before the global domain for

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }
+
+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+class CudaEvent {
+  public:
+    CudaEvent() { CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&event_)); }
+    CudaEvent(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
+    CudaEvent& operator=(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
+    ~CudaEvent() { cudaEventDestroy(event_); }
+    cudaEvent_t get() const noexcept { return event_; }
+
+  private:
+    cudaEvent_t event_{};
+};

+size_t divideRoundUp(const size_t value, const size_t divisor) {

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// Evaluate two Jacobi time steps in one launch.  The first step is computed for
+// the output tile plus a one-cell halo; consequently every value needed by the

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }
+
+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};

+    cudaEvent_t get() const noexcept { return event_; }

+  private:

+};

+// A warp covers one contiguous 32-cell X row.  X neighbours are exchanged
+// through shuffle instructions; only the two edge lanes fetch halo values.
+// Threads then sweep a short Z slab, retaining the previous/current planes in
+// registers.
+constexpr unsigned kWarpWidth = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpTileY = 1;
+constexpr unsigned kWarpsPerBlock = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockTileY = kWarpTileY * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kThreadsPerBlock = kWarpWidth * kWarpsPerBlock;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 16;
+
+constexpr unsigned kTemporalX = 16;
+constexpr unsigned kTemporalY = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kTemporalZ = 8;
+constexpr unsigned kTemporalThreads = 256;

+constexpr unsigned kInputY = kTemporalY + 4;
+constexpr unsigned kInputZ = kTemporalZ + 4;
+constexpr unsigned kInputPitch = kInputX + 1;
+constexpr unsigned kMiddleX = kTemporalX + 2;
+constexpr unsigned kMiddleY = kTemporalY + 2;
+constexpr unsigned kMiddleZ = kTemporalZ + 2;
+constexpr unsigned kMiddlePitch = kMiddleX + 1;

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
     }
