+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// Evaluate two Jacobi time steps in one launch.  The first step is computed for
+// the output tile plus a one-cell halo; consequently every value needed by the
+// second step is local and no inter-block synchronization is required.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTemporalThreads)

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }
+
+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+class CudaEvent {
+  public:
+    CudaEvent() { CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&event_)); }
+    CudaEvent(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
+    CudaEvent& operator=(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
+    ~CudaEvent() { cudaEventDestroy(event_); }
+    cudaEvent_t get() const noexcept { return event_; }
+
+  private:
+    cudaEvent_t event_{};
+};

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+class DeviceGrid {

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }
+
+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+        if (globalX < nx && globalY < ny && globalZ < nz) {
+            const Real center = initial[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 1];
+            if (globalX == 0 || globalX + 1 == nx
+                || globalY == 0 || globalY + 1 == ny
+                || globalZ == 0 || globalZ + 1 == nz) {
+                value = center;
+            } else {
+                value = (center
+                       + initial[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX]
+                       + initial[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 2]
+                       + initial[localZ + 1][localY][localX + 1]
+                       + initial[localZ + 1][localY + 2][localX + 1]
+                       + initial[localZ][localY + 1][localX + 1]
+                       + initial[localZ + 2][localY + 1][localX + 1]) / 7.0;
             }
         }
+        middle[localZ][localY][localX] = value;
     }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    constexpr unsigned outputPlaneCells = kTemporalX * kTemporalY;
+    constexpr unsigned outputCells = outputPlaneCells * kTemporalZ;
+    for (unsigned local = thread; local < outputCells; local += kTemporalThreads) {
+        const unsigned localZ = local / outputPlaneCells;
+        const unsigned inPlane = local - localZ * outputPlaneCells;
+        const unsigned localY = inPlane / kTemporalX;
+        const unsigned localX = inPlane - localY * kTemporalX;
+        const size_t globalX = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTemporalX + localX;
+        const size_t globalY = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTemporalY + localY;
+        const size_t globalZ = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kTemporalZ + localZ;
+        if (globalX < nx - 1 && globalY < ny - 1 && globalZ < nz - 1) {
+            const Real center = middle[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 1];
+            const Real sum = center
+                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX]
+                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 2]
+                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY][localX + 1]
+                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY + 2][localX + 1]
+                           + middle[localZ][localY + 1][localX + 1]
+                           + middle[localZ + 2][localY + 1][localX + 1];
+            output[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX] = sum / 7.0;
+        }
+    }

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }

+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }

+  private:

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }

+// Evaluate two Jacobi time steps in one launch.  The first step is computed for
+// the output tile plus a one-cell halo; consequently every value needed by the
+// second step is local and no inter-block synchronization is required.
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTemporalThreads)
+void stencilTwoStepsKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }

+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};

+class CudaEvent {

+  private:
+    cudaEvent_t event_{};

    33	// A warp covers one contiguous 32-cell X row.  X neighbours are exchanged
    34	// through shuffle instructions; only the two edge lanes fetch halo values.

    58	__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
    59	                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
    60	    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    61	    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
    62	    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
    63	        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
    64	        first[index] = value;
    65	        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
    66	    }

    69	__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
    70	void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
    71	                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    72	    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);
    73	    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x / kWarpWidth;
    74	    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
    75	    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
    76	    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
    77	    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
    78	                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
    79	    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
    80	
    81	    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
    82	        return;
    83	    }
    84	
    85	    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
    86	    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
    87	    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
    88	    const unsigned active = __activemask();
    89	    Real below = input[index - plane];
    90	    Real center = input[index];
    91	
    92	#pragma unroll 4
    93	    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
    94	        const Real above = input[index + plane];
    95	        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
    96	        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
    97	        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
    98	        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
    99	        const Real left = localX != 0
   100	            ? shuffledLeft
   101	            : input[index - 1];
   102	        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
   103	            ? shuffledRight
   104	            : input[index + 1];
   105	        const Real front = input[index - nx];
   106	        const Real back = input[index + nx];
   107	
   108	        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
   109	        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
   110	        below = center;
   111	        center = above;
   112	    }
   113	}
   114	
   115	// Evaluate two Jacobi time steps in one launch.  The first step is computed for
   116	// the output tile plus a one-cell halo; consequently every value needed by the
   117	// second step is local and no inter-block synchronization is required.
   118	__global__ __launch_bounds__(kTemporalThreads)
   119	void stencilTwoStepsKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input,
   120	                           Real* __restrict__ output,
   121	                           const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
   122	    __shared__ Real initial[kInputZ][kInputY][kInputPitch];
   123	    __shared__ Real middle[kMiddleZ][kMiddleY][kMiddlePitch];
   124	
   125	    const unsigned thread = threadIdx.x;
   126	    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
   127	    constexpr unsigned inputPlaneCells = kInputX * kInputY;
   128	    constexpr unsigned inputCells = inputPlaneCells * kInputZ;
   129	
   130	    // The radius-two input starts one coordinate before the global domain for
   131	    // the first block.  Out-of-domain padding is never consumed by a valid
   132	    // output, but defining it keeps every shared-memory location deterministic.
   133	    for (unsigned local = thread; local < inputCells; local += kTemporalThreads) {
   134	        const unsigned localZ = local / inputPlaneCells;
   135	        const unsigned inPlane = local - localZ * inputPlaneCells;
   136	        const unsigned localY = inPlane / kInputX;
   137	        const unsigned localX = inPlane - localY * kInputX;
   138	        const long long globalX = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.x) * kTemporalX
   139	                                + localX - 1;
   140	        const long long globalY = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.y) * kTemporalY
   141	                                + localY - 1;
   142	        const long long globalZ = static_cast<long long>(blockIdx.z) * kTemporalZ
   143	                                + localZ - 1;
   144	        Real value = 0.0;
   145	        if (globalX >= 0 && globalY >= 0 && globalZ >= 0
   146	            && static_cast<size_t>(globalX) < nx
   147	            && static_cast<size_t>(globalY) < ny
   148	            && static_cast<size_t>(globalZ) < nz) {
   149	            value = input[static_cast<size_t>(globalZ) * plane
   150	                        + static_cast<size_t>(globalY) * nx
   151	                        + static_cast<size_t>(globalX)];
   152	        }
   153	        initial[localZ][localY][localX] = value;
   154	    }
   155	    __syncthreads();
   156	
   157	    constexpr unsigned middlePlaneCells = kMiddleX * kMiddleY;
   158	    constexpr unsigned middleCells = middlePlaneCells * kMiddleZ;
   159	    for (unsigned local = thread; local < middleCells; local += kTemporalThreads) {
   160	        const unsigned localZ = local / middlePlaneCells;
   161	        const unsigned inPlane = local - localZ * middlePlaneCells;
   162	        const unsigned localY = inPlane / kMiddleX;
   163	        const unsigned localX = inPlane - localY * kMiddleX;
   164	        const size_t globalX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTemporalX + localX;
   165	        const size_t globalY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTemporalY + localY;
   166	        const size_t globalZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kTemporalZ + localZ;
   167	        Real value = 0.0;
   168	        if (globalX < nx && globalY < ny && globalZ < nz) {
   169	            const Real center = initial[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 1];
   170	            if (globalX == 0 || globalX + 1 == nx
   171	                || globalY == 0 || globalY + 1 == ny
   172	                || globalZ == 0 || globalZ + 1 == nz) {
   173	                value = center;
   174	            } else {
   175	                value = (center
   176	                       + initial[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX]
   177	                       + initial[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 2]
   178	                       + initial[localZ + 1][localY][localX + 1]
   179	                       + initial[localZ + 1][localY + 2][localX + 1]
   180	                       + initial[localZ][localY + 1][localX + 1]
   181	                       + initial[localZ + 2][localY + 1][localX + 1]) / 7.0;
   182	            }
   183	        }
   184	        middle[localZ][localY][localX] = value;
   185	    }
   186	    __syncthreads();
   187	
   188	    constexpr unsigned outputPlaneCells = kTemporalX * kTemporalY;
   189	    constexpr unsigned outputCells = outputPlaneCells * kTemporalZ;
   190	    for (unsigned local = thread; local < outputCells; local += kTemporalThreads) {
   191	        const unsigned localZ = local / outputPlaneCells;
   192	        const unsigned inPlane = local - localZ * outputPlaneCells;
   193	        const unsigned localY = inPlane / kTemporalX;
   194	        const unsigned localX = inPlane - localY * kTemporalX;
   195	        const size_t globalX = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kTemporalX + localX;
   196	        const size_t globalY = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kTemporalY + localY;
   197	        const size_t globalZ = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kTemporalZ + localZ;
   198	        if (globalX < nx - 1 && globalY < ny - 1 && globalZ < nz - 1) {
   199	            const Real center = middle[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 1];
   200	            const Real sum = center
   201	                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX]
   202	                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY + 1][localX + 2]
   203	                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY][localX + 1]
   204	                           + middle[localZ + 1][localY + 2][localX + 1]
   205	                           + middle[localZ][localY + 1][localX + 1]
   206	                           + middle[localZ + 2][localY + 1][localX + 1];
   207	            output[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX] = sum / 7.0;
   208	        }
   209	    }
   210	}
   211	
   212	class DeviceGrid {
   213	  public:
   214	    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
   215	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
   216	    }
   217	
   218	    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
   219	    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
   220	
   221	    ~DeviceGrid() {
   222	        if (data_ != nullptr) {
   223	            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
   224	            cudaFree(data_);
   225	        }
   226	    }
   227	
   228	    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }
   229	
   230	  private:
   231	    Real* data_ = nullptr;
   232	};
   233	
   234	class CudaEvent {
   235	  public:
   236	    CudaEvent() { CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&event_)); }
   237	    CudaEvent(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
   238	    CudaEvent& operator=(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
   239	    ~CudaEvent() { cudaEventDestroy(event_); }
   240	    cudaEvent_t get() const noexcept { return event_; }
   241	
   242	  private:
   243	    cudaEvent_t event_{};
   244	};
   245	
   246	size_t divideRoundUp(const size_t value, const size_t divisor) {
   247	    return value / divisor + (value % divisor != 0);
   248	}
   249	
   250	bool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid) {
   251	    for (const Real value : grid) {
   252	        if (std::isnan(value) || std::isinf(value)) {
   253	            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
   254	            return false;
   255	        }
   256	    }
   257	
   258	    Real minValue = grid[0];
   259	    Real maxValue = grid[0];
   260	    for (const Real value : grid) {
   261	        minValue = std::min(minValue, value);
   262	        maxValue = std::max(maxValue, value);
   263	    }
   264	
   265	    std::printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", minValue, maxValue);
   266	    if (maxValue > 1e6 || minValue < -1e6) {
   267	        std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   268	        return false;
   269	    }
   270	    return true;
   271	}
   272	
   273	void printUsage(const char* const programName) {
   274	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);
   275	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   276	    std::printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\n");
   277	    std::printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
   278	    std::printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
   279	    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\n");
   280	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   281	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   282	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   283	}
   284	
   285	}  // namespace
   286	
   287	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   288	    size_t nx = 128;
   289	    size_t ny = 0;
   290	    size_t nz = 0;
   291	    int iterations = 10;
   292	    bool validate = false;
   293	    bool printResults = false;
   294	
   295	    for (int argument = 1; argument < argc; ++argument) {
   296	        if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-x") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
   297	            nx = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
   298	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-y") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
   299	            ny = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
   300	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-z") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
   301	            nz = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
   302	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-i") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
   303	            iterations = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
   304	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-v") == 0) {
   305	            validate = true;
   306	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-r") == 0) {
   307	            printResults = true;
   308	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-h") == 0) {
   309	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   310	            return 0;
   310	            return 0;
   311	        } else {
   312	            std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[argument]);
   313	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   314	            return 1;
   315	        }
   316	    }
   317	
   318	    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;
   319	    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;
   320	
   321	    std::printf("3D Stencil Benchmark\n");
   322	    std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
   323	    std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", iterations);
   324	    std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   325	
   326	    if (nx != 0 && ny > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nx) {
   327	        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid dimensions overflow addressable memory\n");
   328	        return 1;
   329	    }
   330	    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
   331	    if (plane != 0 && nz > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / plane) {
   332	        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid dimensions overflow addressable memory\n");
   333	        return 1;
   334	    }
   335	    const size_t gridSize = plane * nz;
   336	    if (gridSize == 0 || gridSize > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(Real)) {
   337	        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid must contain at least one addressable element\n");
   338	        return 1;
   339	    }
   340	    const size_t bytes = gridSize * sizeof(Real);
   341	
   342	    DeviceGrid grid1(bytes);
   343	    DeviceGrid grid2(bytes);
   344	
   345	    std::printf("Initializing grid...\n");
   346	    constexpr unsigned initializationThreads = 256;
   347	    const size_t neededBlocks = divideRoundUp(gridSize, initializationThreads);
   348	    const unsigned initializationBlocks = static_cast<unsigned>(
   349	        std::min<size_t>(neededBlocks, 65535));
   350	    initializeGrids<<<initializationBlocks, initializationThreads>>>(
   351	        grid1.get(), grid2.get(), gridSize, iterations > 0);
   352	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   353	
   354	    std::printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
   355	    CudaEvent start;
   356	    CudaEvent stop;
   357	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(start.get()));
   358	
   359	    Real* input = grid1.get();
   360	    Real* output = grid2.get();
   361	    if (iterations > 0 && nx > 2 && ny > 2 && nz > 2) {
   362	        const dim3 temporalBlocks(
   363	            static_cast<unsigned>(divideRoundUp(nx - 2, kTemporalX)),
   364	            static_cast<unsigned>(divideRoundUp(ny - 2, kTemporalY)),
   365	            static_cast<unsigned>(divideRoundUp(nz - 2, kTemporalZ)));
   366	        const dim3 singleStepBlocks(
   367	            static_cast<unsigned>(divideRoundUp(nx - 2, kWarpTileX)),
   368	            static_cast<unsigned>(divideRoundUp(ny - 2, kBlockTileY)),
   369	            static_cast<unsigned>(divideRoundUp(nz - 2, kZSlab)));
   370	
   371	        for (int iteration = 0; iteration + 1 < iterations; iteration += 2) {
   372	            stencilTwoStepsKernel<<<temporalBlocks, kTemporalThreads>>>(
   373	                input, output, nx, ny, nz);
   374	            std::swap(input, output);
   375	        }
   376	        if ((iterations & 1) != 0) {
   377	            stencilKernel<<<singleStepBlocks, kThreadsPerBlock>>>(
   378	                input, output, nx, ny, nz);
   379	            std::swap(input, output);
   380	        }
   381	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   382	    } else if (iterations > 0 && (iterations & 1) != 0) {
   383	        // With no interior points, each iteration only copies the boundaries.
   384	        // Both device buffers already contain those invariant values.
   385	        std::swap(input, output);
   386	    } else if (iterations < 0 && (iterations % 2) != 0) {
   387	        // Preserve the original program's selection of its untouched zeroed
   388	        // second buffer for a negative odd iteration count.
   389	        std::swap(input, output);
   390	    }
   391	
   392	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(stop.get()));
   393	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(stop.get()));
   394	    float elapsedMilliseconds = 0.0F;
   395	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventElapsedTime(&elapsedMilliseconds, start.get(), stop.get()));
   396	
   397	    std::printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n",
   398	                static_cast<long>(elapsedMilliseconds));
   399	    const double interiorCells = (nx > 2 && ny > 2 && nz > 2)
   400	        ? static_cast<double>(nx - 2) * static_cast<double>(ny - 2)
   401	            * static_cast<double>(nz - 2)
   402	        : 0.0;
   403	    const double cellUpdates = interiorCells * static_cast<double>(iterations);
   404	    const double mcups = cellUpdates / (static_cast<double>(elapsedMilliseconds) * 1e3);
   405	    std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   406	
   407	    std::vector<Real> finalGrid;
   408	    if (printResults || validate) {
   409	        finalGrid.resize(gridSize);
   410	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(finalGrid.data(), input, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   411	    }
   412	
   413	    if (printResults) {
   414	        print_results(finalGrid, "Grid");
   415	    }
   416	
   417	    if (validate) {
   418	        std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   419	        if (validateResult(finalGrid)) {
   420	            std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
   421	            return 0;
   422	        }
   423	        std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
   424	        return 1;
   425	    }
   426	
   427	    return 0;
   428	}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kThreadsPerBlock)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & (kWarpWidth - 1);

+    const unsigned localX = lane & (kWarpTileX - 1);
+    const unsigned localY = lane / kWarpTileX;
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kWarpTileX + localX;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockTileY
+                   + warp * kWarpTileY + localY;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    const unsigned active = __activemask();
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        // Every active lane must participate in each synchronized shuffle;
+        // edge lanes select the corresponding global halo value afterwards.
+        const Real shuffledLeft = __shfl_up_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real shuffledRight = __shfl_down_sync(active, center, 1);
+        const Real left = localX != 0
+            ? shuffledLeft
+            : input[index - 1];
+        const Real right = localX + 1 < kWarpTileX && x + 1 < nx - 1
+            ? shuffledRight
+            : input[index + 1];
+        const Real front = input[index - nx];
+        const Real back = input[index + nx];
+
+        const Real sum = center + left + right + front + back + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
+}

+// second step is local and no inter-block synchronization is required.

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }

+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
+        }
+    }

+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }

+  private:

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
     }
 }

+class DeviceGrid {
+  public:
+    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
+    }
+
+    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceGrid() {
+        if (data_ != nullptr) {
+            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
+            cudaFree(data_);
         }
     }
+
+    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }

+  private:
+    Real* data_ = nullptr;
+};

+// X is a full warp wide for coalesced accesses. Each thread advances through a
+// short Z slab, retaining the two Z-neighbour values in registers. This lowers
+// the steady-state input traffic from seven loads to five per update while the
+// independent slabs provide enough blocks to saturate large GPUs.
+constexpr unsigned kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 8;

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
+    }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;

+    Real center = input[index];

+        center = above;
+    }

+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
 }

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,

+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;

+    Real center = input[index];

+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

using Real = double;

namespace {

[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
                              const char* file, const int line) {
    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
}

#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
    do {                                                                         \
        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                       \
        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                   \
            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);      \
        }                                                                        \
    } while (false)

// X is a full warp wide for coalesced accesses. Each thread advances through a
// short Z slab, retaining the two Z-neighbour values in registers. This lowers
// the steady-state input traffic from seven loads to five per update while the
// independent slabs provide enough blocks to saturate large GPUs.
constexpr unsigned kBlockX = 32;
constexpr unsigned kBlockY = 4;
constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 8;

__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
        first[index] = value;
        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
    }
}

__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;

    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
        return;
    }

    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
    Real below = input[index - plane];
    Real center = input[index];

#pragma unroll 4
    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
        const Real above = input[index + plane];
        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
                       + below + above;
        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
        below = center;
        center = above;
    }
}

class DeviceGrid {
  public:
    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
    }

    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;

    ~DeviceGrid() {
        if (data_ != nullptr) {
            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
            cudaFree(data_);
        }
    }

    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }

  private:
    Real* data_ = nullptr;
};

class CudaEvent {
  public:
    CudaEvent() { CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&event_)); }
    CudaEvent(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
    CudaEvent& operator=(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
    ~CudaEvent() { cudaEventDestroy(event_); }
    cudaEvent_t get() const noexcept { return event_; }

  private:
    cudaEvent_t event_{};
};

size_t divideRoundUp(const size_t value, const size_t divisor) {
    return value / divisor + (value % divisor != 0);
}

bool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid) {
    for (const Real value : grid) {
        if (std::isnan(value) || std::isinf(value)) {
            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
            return false;
        }
    }

    Real minValue = grid[0];
    Real maxValue = grid[0];
    for (const Real value : grid) {
        minValue = std::min(minValue, value);
        maxValue = std::max(maxValue, value);
    }

    std::printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", minValue, maxValue);
    if (maxValue > 1e6 || minValue < -1e6) {
        std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* const programName) {
    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);
    std::printf("Options:\n");
    std::printf("  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\n");
    std::printf("  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    std::printf("  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\n");
    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\n");
    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    size_t nx = 128;
    size_t ny = 0;
    size_t nz = 0;
    int iterations = 10;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;

    for (int argument = 1; argument < argc; ++argument) {
        if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-x") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
            nx = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-y") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
            ny = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-z") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
            nz = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-i") == 0 && argument + 1 < argc) {
            iterations = std::atoi(argv[++argument]);
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[argument], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
        } else {
            std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[argument]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }

    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;
    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;

    std::printf("3D Stencil Benchmark\n");
    std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
    std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", iterations);
    std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");

    if (nx != 0 && ny > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / nx) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid dimensions overflow addressable memory\n");
        return 1;
    }
    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
    if (plane != 0 && nz > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / plane) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid dimensions overflow addressable memory\n");
        return 1;
    }
    const size_t gridSize = plane * nz;
    if (gridSize == 0 || gridSize > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(Real)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid must contain at least one addressable element\n");
        return 1;
    }
    const size_t bytes = gridSize * sizeof(Real);

    DeviceGrid grid1(bytes);
    DeviceGrid grid2(bytes);

    std::printf("Initializing grid...\n");
    constexpr unsigned initializationThreads = 256;
    const size_t neededBlocks = divideRoundUp(gridSize, initializationThreads);
    const unsigned initializationBlocks = static_cast<unsigned>(
        std::min<size_t>(neededBlocks, 65535));
    initializeGrids<<<initializationBlocks, initializationThreads>>>(
        grid1.get(), grid2.get(), gridSize, iterations > 0);
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetCacheConfig(stencilKernel, cudaFuncCachePreferL1));

    std::printf("Running stencil computation...\n");
    CudaEvent start;
    CudaEvent stop;
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(start.get()));

    Real* input = grid1.get();
    Real* output = grid2.get();
    if (iterations > 0 && nx > 2 && ny > 2 && nz > 2) {
        const dim3 threads(kBlockX, kBlockY, 1);
        const dim3 blocks(
            static_cast<unsigned>(divideRoundUp(nx - 2, kBlockX)),
            static_cast<unsigned>(divideRoundUp(ny - 2, kBlockY)),
            static_cast<unsigned>(divideRoundUp(nz - 2, kZSlab)));

        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < iterations; ++iteration) {
            stencilKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(input, output, nx, ny, nz);
            std::swap(input, output);
        }
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    } else if (iterations > 0 && (iterations & 1) != 0) {
        // With no interior points, each iteration only copies the boundaries.
        // Both device buffers already contain those invariant values.
        std::swap(input, output);
    } else if (iterations < 0 && (iterations % 2) != 0) {
        // Preserve the original program's selection of its untouched zeroed
        // second buffer for a negative odd iteration count.
        std::swap(input, output);
    }

    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(stop.get()));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(stop.get()));
    float elapsedMilliseconds = 0.0F;
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventElapsedTime(&elapsedMilliseconds, start.get(), stop.get()));

    std::printf("Computation time: %ld ms\n",
                static_cast<long>(elapsedMilliseconds));
    const double interiorCells = (nx > 2 && ny > 2 && nz > 2)
        ? static_cast<double>(nx - 2) * static_cast<double>(ny - 2)
            * static_cast<double>(nz - 2)
        : 0.0;
    const double cellUpdates = interiorCells * static_cast<double>(iterations);
    const double mcups = cellUpdates / (static_cast<double>(elapsedMilliseconds) * 1e3);
    std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);

    std::vector<Real> finalGrid;
    if (printResults || validate) {
        finalGrid.resize(gridSize);
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(finalGrid.data(), input, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    }

    if (printResults) {
        print_results(finalGrid, "Grid");
    }

    if (validate) {
        std::printf("Validating result...\n");
        if (validateResult(finalGrid)) {
            std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        }
        std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
 }

+// X is a full warp wide for coalesced accesses. Each thread advances through a
+// short Z slab, retaining the two Z-neighbour values in registers. This lowers
+// the steady-state input traffic from seven loads to five per update while the
+// independent slabs provide enough blocks to saturate large GPUs.
+constexpr unsigned kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockY = 4;

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
+    }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }

+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;

+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+

+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {

+        center = above;
+    }

+// X is a full warp wide for coalesced accesses. Each thread advances through a
+// short Z slab, retaining the two Z-neighbour values in registers. This lowers
+// the steady-state input traffic from seven loads to five per update while the
+// independent slabs provide enough blocks to saturate large GPUs.
+constexpr unsigned kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 8;

+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
+    }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }

    18	[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
    19	                              const char* file, const int line) {
    20	    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
    21	                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
    22	    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);

    25	#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
    26	    do {                                                                         \
    27	        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                       \
    28	        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                   \

    33	// X is a full warp wide for coalesced accesses. Each thread advances through a
    34	// short Z slab, retaining the two Z-neighbour values in registers. This lowers
    35	// the steady-state input traffic from seven loads to five per update while the
    36	// independent slabs provide enough blocks to saturate large GPUs.
    37	constexpr unsigned kBlockX = 32;
    38	constexpr unsigned kBlockY = 4;
    39	constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 8;
    40	
    41	__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
    42	                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
    43	    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    44	    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
    45	    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
    46	        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
    47	        first[index] = value;
    48	        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
    49	    }
    50	}
    51	
    52	__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
    53	void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
    54	                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
    55	    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
    56	    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
    57	    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
    58	
    59	    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
    60	        return;
    61	    }
    62	
    63	    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
    64	    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
    65	    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
    66	    Real below = input[index - plane];
    67	    Real center = input[index];
    68	
    69	#pragma unroll 4
    70	    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
    71	        const Real above = input[index + plane];
    72	        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
    73	                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
    74	                       + below + above;
    75	        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
    76	        below = center;
    77	        center = above;
    78	    }
    79	}
    80	
    81	class DeviceGrid {
    82	  public:
    83	    explicit DeviceGrid(const size_t bytes) {
    84	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&data_), bytes));
    85	    }
    86	
    87	    DeviceGrid(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
    88	    DeviceGrid& operator=(const DeviceGrid&) = delete;
    89	
    90	    ~DeviceGrid() {
    91	        if (data_ != nullptr) {
    92	            // All checked CUDA work is complete before normal destruction.
    93	            cudaFree(data_);
    94	        }
    95	    }
    96	
    97	    Real* get() const noexcept { return data_; }
    98	
    99	  private:
   100	    Real* data_ = nullptr;
   101	};
   102	
   103	class CudaEvent {
   104	  public:
   105	    CudaEvent() { CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&event_)); }
   106	    CudaEvent(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
   107	    CudaEvent& operator=(const CudaEvent&) = delete;
   108	    ~CudaEvent() { cudaEventDestroy(event_); }
   109	    cudaEvent_t get() const noexcept { return event_; }
   110	
   111	  private:
   112	    cudaEvent_t event_{};
   113	};

   115	size_t divideRoundUp(const size_t value, const size_t divisor) {
   116	    return value / divisor + (value % divisor != 0);
   117	}
   118	
   119	bool validateResult(const std::vector<Real>& grid) {
   120	    for (const Real value : grid) {
   121	        if (std::isnan(value) || std::isinf(value)) {
   122	            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
   123	            return false;
   124	        }
   125	    }
   126	
   127	    Real minValue = grid[0];
   128	    Real maxValue = grid[0];
   129	    for (const Real value : grid) {
   130	        minValue = std::min(minValue, value);
   131	        maxValue = std::max(maxValue, value);
   132	    }
   133	
   134	    std::printf("Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", minValue, maxValue);
   135	    if (maxValue > 1e6 || minValue < -1e6) {
   136	        std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   137	        return false;
   138	    }
   139	    return true;
   140	}

+// X is a full warp wide for coalesced accesses. Each thread advances through a
+// short Z slab, retaining the two Z-neighbour values in registers. This lowers
+// the steady-state input traffic from seven loads to five per update while the
+// independent slabs provide enough blocks to saturate large GPUs.
+constexpr unsigned kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 8;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
+    }
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
 }

codex
Implemented an unconditional CUDA version while preserving the `stencil3d` executable name.

Key changes:

- GPU-resident double buffers with only the final result copied back.
- Coalesced 32×4 blocks and register-swept 8-plane Z slabs.
- GPU initialization and CUDA event timing.
- Fixed boundaries preserved exactly.
- CUDA error handling and overflow checks.
- CMake now compiles the existing `.cpp` with NVCC for the native GPU architecture.
- No new source files or dependencies.

Validation:

- Exact full-array hashes matched the CPU implementation across seven cubic, non-cubic, boundary-only, odd/even, and zero-iteration cases.
- `256³`, 20 iterations: validation passed.
- RTX 3090 sustained approximately 19.2 billion cell updates/second.

Modified files: [stencil3d.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/stencil3d_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_cuda_r1/stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp) and [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/stencil3d_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_cuda_r1/stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt).

+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (expression);                       \
+        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                   \
+            cudaFailure(cuda_check_error, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);      \
+        }                                                                        \
+    } while (false)
+
+// X is a full warp wide for coalesced accesses. Each thread advances through a
+// short Z slab, retaining the two Z-neighbour values in registers. This lowers
+// the steady-state input traffic from seven loads to five per update while the
+// independent slabs provide enough blocks to saturate large GPUs.
+constexpr unsigned kBlockX = 32;
+constexpr unsigned kBlockY = 4;
+constexpr unsigned kZSlab = 8;
+
+__global__ void initializeGrids(Real* const first, Real* const second,
+                                const size_t count, const bool initializeSecond) {
+    const size_t firstIndex = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) * gridDim.x;
+    for (size_t index = firstIndex; index < count; index += stride) {
+        const Real value = static_cast<Real>(index % 19);
+        first[index] = value;
+        second[index] = initializeSecond ? value : 0.0;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(kBlockX * kBlockY)
+void stencilKernel(const Real* __restrict__ input, Real* __restrict__ output,
+                   const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {
+    const size_t x = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * kBlockX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * kBlockY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t zBegin = 1 + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * kZSlab;
+
+    if (x >= nx - 1 || y >= ny - 1 || zBegin >= nz - 1) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const size_t plane = nx * ny;
+    size_t index = zBegin * plane + y * nx + x;
+    const size_t zEnd = min(zBegin + static_cast<size_t>(kZSlab), nz - 1);
+    Real below = input[index - plane];
+    Real center = input[index];
+
+#pragma unroll 4
+    for (size_t z = zBegin; z < zEnd; ++z, index += plane) {
+        const Real above = input[index + plane];
+        const Real sum = center + input[index - 1] + input[index + 1]
+                       + input[index - nx] + input[index + nx]
+                       + below + above;
+        output[index] = sum / 7.0;
+        below = center;
+        center = above;
+    }
 }

Implemented an unconditional CUDA version while preserving the `stencil3d` executable name.

Key changes:

- GPU-resident double buffers with only the final result copied back.
- Coalesced 32×4 blocks and register-swept 8-plane Z slabs.
- GPU initialization and CUDA event timing.
- Fixed boundaries preserved exactly.
- CUDA error handling and overflow checks.
- CMake now compiles the existing `.cpp` with NVCC for the native GPU architecture.
- No new source files or dependencies.

Validation:

- Exact full-array hashes matched the CPU implementation across seven cubic, non-cubic, boundary-only, odd/even, and zero-iteration cases.
- `256³`, 20 iterations: validation passed.
- RTX 3090 sustained approximately 19.2 billion cell updates/second.
